title: Dolan's early appearances and Stanton Friedman pressing him on Bob Lazar

tellings.quote: Um so, I mean, I'm there and Stan like I'm sitting alone with him and he's checking me out. He's like, "Who is this guy?" Because I just written a a book, big fat book, and uh he's like, "So, what's your opinion on Bob Lazar?"

plain: Around 2001, at early talks in places like Laughlin, Nevada, and St. Louis, Missouri, the well-known UFO researcher Stanton Friedman sat him down alone and tested him, says the UFO historian Richard Dolan, who tells it as something that happened to him. Dolan says he had just written a big, fat book and Friedman was sizing him up, asking him straight out, "So, what's your opinion on Bob Lazar?" Lazar is a man who says he worked on alien craft for the government.
